verdict.rationale: CIPO is a government IP-office service, so headless or programmatic automation (for example, filing or search APIs usable from CI) is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows only web-based online services, account-gated MyCIPO portals, and downloadable bulk data. Bulk downloads are an adjacent data-access feature, not a documented headless or CI-runnable interface, so there is no evidence the product delivers this story.
